Meta.defaultDescription: ISHINOL is a premium Japanese protection coating for marble. PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama is the official ISHINOL distributor in Indonesia.

Home.heroEyebrow: Official ISHINOL Japan Agent in Indonesia
Home.heroSubheadline: ISHINOL penetrates deep into natural stone — not just coating the surface — cutting water absorption by over 75% and protecting marble from stains, weathering and the elements. Trusted by marble factories and warehouses across Indonesia for over 25 years.
Home.aboutBody: PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama is the official Indonesian agent for ISHINOL coating, made by Konsho, Japan. For over 25 years we have worked closely with marble factories and warehouses across the country.
Home.whySubtitle: Japanese penetrating technology that protects marble from within.
Home.productsSubtitle: A full range of ISHINOL coatings and cleaning agents for marble care.

Home.projectsSubtitle: Trusted by luxury residences, hotels and landmark buildings.

About.title: About PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama
About.intro: PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama is the official distributor of ISHINOL — premium Japanese marble protection — in Indonesia.
About.japanBody: ISHINOL is born from decades of Japanese marble-coating science. As the appointed distributor for Indonesia, PT Indocoat Ishinol Utama imports every product directly from the source, ensuring authenticity, technical support, and the uncompromising quality that defines the ISHINOL name in Japan.
About.value1Body: Every product is genuine, imported directly from ISHINOL Japan.
About.value2Body: Japanese precision applied by certified, professional specialists.
About.value3Body: Long-term partnerships built on transparency and results.
About.value4Body: An uncompromising standard on every surface we protect.
About.ctaBody: Speak with our specialists about protecting your most valuable surfaces.
